Monster Beverage new entrant threat energy drink category 2026 Ghost Prime

findings.claim: 10-K 自述持續面對能量飲料、能量shot、啤酒及 beyond beer 類別的新進入者；功能性飲料業者（BODYARMOR、Prime、Starbucks 等）加入補充成分搶位，公司認為其成分含量較低、定位不同。
findings.excerpt: We have experienced and continue to experience competition from new entrants in the energy drink, energy shot, beer and beyond beer categories.

findings.claim: 競爭對手整併與配銷結盟：KDP 配銷 C4、Bloom 並同意收購 GHOST；Celsius 收購 Alani Nu；PepsiCo 2022 年與 Celsius 簽長期配銷協議。
findings.excerpt: KDP, which distributes C4 and Bloom, entered into a long-term sales and distribution agreement with Black Rifle Coffee Company as well as a definitive agreement to acquire GHOST Lifestyle LLC and GHOST Beverages LLC. In addition, Celsius Holdings, Inc. (“CELSIUS”) acquired Alani Nutrition LLC (“Alani Nu”).

findings.claim: 公司風險因子承認競爭壓力可能導致價格侵蝕與市占下滑，並無法保證維持現有市占。
findings.excerpt: Competitive pressures in the energy drink category could impact our revenues, cause price erosion and/or lower our market share, any of which could have a material adverse effect on our business and results of operations.

findings.claim: Monster 投資人簡報（8-K 附件）引 Nielsen 美國能量飲料金額份額：Red Bull、Celsius、Alani Nu 等對手份額。
